fusions.name: Herd Press
fusions.desc: The herd presses outward, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles. You heal 12 health.

fusions.name: Weight of the Herd
fusions.desc: A crushing blow that deals 30 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Shared Warmth
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you and every ally within 5 tiles.

fusions.name: Winter Byre
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 5%. It also hardens your armour by 10% and regenerates 1.5 health a second, permanently.
